+    def _unescape_args_and_kwargs(self, name: str) -> str:
+        """Unescape special characters in argument names.
+        
+        This is the inverse of _escape_args_and_kwargs.
+        """
+        # Unescape in reverse order of escaping
+        # First, handle ** and *
+        if name.startswith(r'\*\*'):
+            name = '**' + name[4:]
+        elif name.startswith(r'\*'):
+            name = '*' + name[2:]
+        
+        # Then handle trailing underscore
+        if name.endswith(r'\_'):
+            name = name[:-2] + '_'
+        
+        return name
